## Input and Flex Mechs bug fixes

- Fixed Spotify, Quick Chat, and other plugin keybinds blocking normal keyboard input in Windows.
- Keyboard and mouse Spotify keybinds now react only while Rocket League is focused; controller media keybinds remain available globally.
- Restricted the BondoMod app show/hide keybind to F1â€“F24 so letters and Windows keys are never captured globally.
- Flex Mechs can now be activated only while Rocket League is running, without requiring the game to be focused.
- Flex Mechs now deactivates automatically and saves the disabled state when Rocket League closes.
- Fixed Flex Mechs controls remaining held after releasing the mechanic keybind or deactivating the plugin.
- Added Rocket League KBM control detection without allowing missing values to overwrite saved controls.
- KBM control fields now record the next keyboard key or mouse button instead of requiring typed names.
- Added mouse-button support for Flex Mechs action controls.
